notes:
Summary:
- Company: Sparrow Lane Analytics — mid-market SaaS that powers in-app product guidance and contextual UX via semantic search over product docs, changelogs, and user sessions.
- Current stack: Postgres for metadata, early FAISS backfill. Evaluating managed vectors for scale and ops (Pinecone/Weaviate) and Redwood for inference + embedding generation.
- POC approach: Start with Redwood Hosted API for embeddings + search evaluation, then move to Dedicated if cost and p99 latency targets are met. Key ask: documented throughput and cost delta for Dedicated vs Hosted for batch + online patterns.
Requirements / targets:
- Real-time similarity queries: target 150-250 QPS, 95th/99th p99 latency goal <100ms for similarity lookup and <300ms end-to-end in-app UI.
- Batch embeddings: nightly ingestion window — ~250k documents/day (initial), expect to grow to 1M+/day in 12 months. Need bulk ingestion tooling, resumable jobs, and predictable cost for high-volume jobs.
- Vector DB integration: must integrate with Pinecone and optionally with their Postgres metadata (hybrid). Metadata join latency is critical. Looking for connector examples / best practices.
- Model prefs: open/quantized models ok if output quality matches; prefer deterministic embedding stability for reindexing.
- Security & compliance: SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS for key management, EU data residency for EU customers. Legal request pending.
- Cost sensitivity: product lead said, "If Dedicated reduces per-embedding cost 3-4x and gives stable p99 under load, we can commit to a 6mo reserved capacity."
POC notes:
- Hosted API demo showed embedding generation latency ~60-120ms per request depending on batch size; bulk job (250k docs) completed overnight but cost heavier than expected.
- SE recommended batching strategies, prefix caching, and using Redwood Optimize suggestions to reduce unit cost.
- They requested an estimated cost model for 6-month commit and a canary rollout plan for Dedicated.
Next steps / asks to Redwood:
- Provide Dedicated pricing worksheet adjusted to their projected volume (linked_drive_docs).
- Run a short stress test (200 QPS sustained for 30m) on Hosted to measure p99 behavior and verify fallback when capacity constrained.
- Share connector docs for Pinecone and Postgres hybrid metadata joins.
- Legal: sample data residency SLA language and SOC2 audit artifacts.
Quoted stakeholders: "Need sub-100ms vector lookup for our search UX — anything slower and our retention drops" — Product Lead (S. Kim).
